issues.title: Missing semicolons in variable declarations
issues.description: The rule requires all JavaScript and TypeScript statements to end with explicit semicolons, but lines 88-90 rely on automatic semicolon insertion (ASI) instead

issues.title: Missing dependency in useEffect causes stale clamp detection
issues.description: The CommentContent component's useEffect hook has an empty dependency array, but it uses item.html to determine if content should be clamped. When a comment's HTML content changes (e.g., after an edit or when new data is loaded), the clamp detection won't re-run. This means the 'Show more' button may appear when it shouldn't or disappear when it should still be visible, creating a poor user experience. The dependency array should include item.html to ensure the clamp detection re-runs whenever the content changes.

issues.title: Filter button becomes non-functional when onAddFilter is undefined
issues.description: The conditional check for rendering the post title button was changed from `item.post?.id && item.post?.title && onAddFilter` to `item.post?.id && item.post?.title`, removing the onAddFilter null check. However, the button's onClick handler still calls onAddFilter('post', item.post!.id). Since onAddFilter is now a required prop in the TypeScript signature but the runtime check was removed, if onAddFilter is ever undefined or null at runtime, clicking the post title button will throw an error and crash the component. The original three-part condition was protecting against this scenario.
issues.problematic_code_snippet: {item.post?.id && item.post?.title ? ( ) : ( Unknown post )}

issues.title: Inconsistent conditional rendering pattern for feature image
issues.description: The feature image rendering logic was changed from a ternary expression with explicit null return (`condition ? : null`) to a logical AND operator (`condition && `). While functionally similar in most cases, this creates an inconsistency: when item.post?.feature_image is falsy (like an empty string ''), the logical AND will render the falsy value (empty string) instead of rendering nothing. This could lead to unexpected DOM nodes or React warnings. The original ternary with explicit null was more defensive and clearer about the intent to render nothing when the condition is false.
issues.problematic_code_snippet: {item.post?.feature_image && ( )}

issues.title: Delete comment functionality completely removed from UI
issues.description: The PR removes the dropdown menu item that allowed users to delete comments, making the delete functionality completely inaccessible through the UI. While all the backend infrastructure remains intact (AlertDialog component, confirmDelete function, deleteComment mutation, commentToDelete state), there is no button or menu item that calls setCommentToDelete to trigger the deletion flow. This is a critical functional regression that removes an essential moderation capability for administrators. Users can no longer delete comments through the interface, even though the API endpoint and confirmation dialog are still present in the code.

issues.description: The added variable/state declarations rely on automatic semicolon insertion (ASI). The codebase rule requires explicit semicolons at the end of all statements.

pr.title: Code Review Bench PR #25745 - Redesigned comment moderation list layout

structured_output.summary:
This PR replaces the comment moderation table in the Posts admin app with a stacked, list-like row layout. Each comment now shows the member (with a filter action), the timestamp, the post title (also a filter action), a clamped body with a "Show more" toggle, Hide/Show buttons, reply/like/report counters with tooltips, and an overflow menu. A post feature image is shown on large screens. The backend mapper now includes `feature_image` in the admin comment `post` payload, and the e2e header snapshots are updated to match.

The layout work is reasonable and the backend change is small and consistent with its snapshots. The main problem is that the redesign silently removed the only UI path to delete a comment. The "Delete comment" menu item was dropped, `handleDeleteClick` was removed, and nothing calls `setCommentToDelete` any more, so the existing "Delete comment?" confirmation dialog can never open. There are also several smaller issues: a behaviour change where the post title no longer opens the editor, an icon-only menu button with no accessible name, a feature image that downloads on mobile even though it is hidden there, and some leftover code (a commented-out avatar block and a regex-based date hack).
structured_output.verdictRationale: The unreachable delete action is a functional regression in a moderation tool. Moderators can still hide and show comments, but they can no longer delete them from this screen. That needs to be fixed before merge. The remaining findings are medium or low and can be handled in this PR or a follow-up.

architecture.overview:
The Posts admin app's comments view (`comments.tsx`) fetches comments through a shared `useInfinite…` query and passes them, along with an `onAddFilter` callback, into `CommentsList`. That component virtualizes the rows with `useInfiniteVirtualScroll`, and each row is a `TableRow` rendered as a stacked grid on small screens and as a table row on `lg`. On the server, the comments output serializer (`mappers/comments.js`) decides which member, post, and count fields are exposed to the admin API.

This PR changes the row from a four-column table (comment, author, post, date, actions) into one left column with a metadata line, a clamped body, and an action bar, plus a right-hand feature image column. The moderation actions (hide, show, and the overflow menu) stay in place, but delete is no longer reachable. On the backend, `feature_image` is added to the post fields exposed on each admin comment, which is the only data the new image column needs.
steps: Entry point: `comments.tsx` fetches the admin comment list and renders `CommentsList`, passing `items`, paging props, and `onAddFilter` (`apps/posts/src/views/comments/comments.tsx`, around line 137).

Server side: `ghost/core/.../output/mappers/comments.js` whitelists fields for `post`; this PR adds `feature_image` (line 39). The Comment type in `admin-x-framework/src/api/comments.ts` gains the matching optional field.
`CommentsList` now receives `onAddFilter` as a required prop, which is safe because the single caller always passes it. The old `&&` guards around filter actions are removed with it.

Each row is rebuilt: a metadata line (member, timestamp tooltip, post title button), a `CommentContent` block that clamps HTML to two lines using `scrollHeight > clientHeight`, an action bar with Hide/Show, count tooltips, and a `DropdownMenu` that now offers only View post and View member.
The delete path is the broken link: the `AlertDialog` still reads `commentToDelete`, but no menu item calls `setCommentToDelete` any more, so the dialog is unreachable.
A new `feature_image` cell is placed in the second grid column and hidden below `lg`. Snapshot updates in `comments.test.js.snap` and the activity-feed header snapshots reflect the extra bytes.

findings.title: Delete comment action removed, leaving the delete dialog unreachable
findings.body:
The redesign drops the "Delete comment" item from the row's overflow menu, along with `handleDeleteClick`. Nothing in the file calls `setCommentToDelete` any more. The `AlertDialog` at the end of the component still depends on `commentToDelete` (opened by `open={!!commentToDelete}`), so it can never open. Moderators can hide and show a comment from this screen but can no longer delete one, which is a functional regression in a moderation tool.

::diff{file="apps/posts/src/views/comments/components/comments-list.tsx" lines="328-345"}

::callout{type="warning"}
The state, confirm handler, and dialog are all still present, so this looks like a partial removal rather than a deliberate one. If delete was meant to move somewhere else, that move is not in this diff.

Restore the menu item and wire it to the existing state. Something like this, placed in the overflow menu after the existing items and guarded by `item.status !== 'deleted'`:

::suggestion{file="apps/posts/src/views/comments/components/comments-list.tsx" lines="343-345"}
                                                    {item.status !== 'deleted' && <>
                                                        <DropdownMenuSeparator />
                                                        <DropdownMenuItem
                                                            className="text-destructive focus:text-destructive"
                                                            onClick={() => setCommentToDelete(item)}
                                                        >
                                                            <LucideIcon.Trash2 className="mr-2 size-4" />
                                                            Delete comment
                                                        </DropdownMenuItem>
                                                    </>}
                                                </DropdownMenuContent>
findings.fixPrompt: In `apps/posts/src/views/comments/components/comments-list.tsx`, the row's overflow `DropdownMenuContent` (around lines 328-345) no longer offers a delete action, but the `commentToDelete` state (line ~150), `confirmDelete` (line ~153), and the `AlertDialog` (line ~366) are still in place. The `handleDeleteClick` helper was removed in this PR, so nothing sets `commentToDelete`. Restore a "Delete comment" `DropdownMenuItem` (with `DropdownMenuSeparator`, the `text-destructive` styling, and the `Trash2` icon) in that menu. It should call `setCommentToDelete(item)` and only render when `item.status !== 'deleted'`. Re-import `DropdownMenuSeparator`, which was removed from the imports. Follow the pattern from the original version of this menu in the base commit.

findings.title: Post title now filters the list instead of opening the post
findings.fixPrompt: In `apps/posts/src/views/comments/components/comments-list.tsx` (around lines 236-243), the post title in each row changed from a link to `#/editor/post/{id}` into a button that only calls `onAddFilter('post', id)`. Moderators have lost the ability to open the post in the editor from this list. Restore that navigation, either by adding a "Edit post" `DropdownMenuItem` linking to `#/editor/post/{id}` next to the existing "View post" item, or by keeping the title as a link. Pick one approach and note it in the PR description if the filter behaviour is intentional.

findings.title: Feature image is downloaded on small screens even though it is hidden
findings.fixPrompt: In `apps/posts/src/views/comments/components/comments-list.tsx` (around lines 350-358), the feature image `` uses `hidden ... lg:block`, so it is hidden below the `lg` breakpoint but still requested. Change it so the image is only rendered at `lg` and up, using a `matchMedia('(min-width: 1024px)')` check or an equivalent existing hook in the codebase. Also add `loading="lazy"` so offscreen images are deferred. Keep the layout the same at `lg`.

findings.title: Icon-only overflow button has no accessible name
findings.fixPrompt: In `apps/posts/src/views/comments/components/comments-list.tsx` (around lines 320-326), the overflow `DropdownMenuTrigger` button contains only an icon, so it has no accessible name. Add an `aria-label` such as "Comment actions". Also, the reply, like, and report counters (around lines 280-320) use `TooltipTrigger asChild` on non-focusable `div`s, so their tooltips are not reachable by keyboard. Make them focusable or add visually hidden text that matches the tooltip.

findings.title: Class strings build a literal "false" when the condition is false
findings.fixPrompt: In `apps/posts/src/views/comments/components/comments-list.tsx`, several `className` template literals use `${condition && 'some-class'}` (around lines 112, 194, 200, and in the replies/likes indicators near line 290). Replace these with a ternary or the `cn()` helper so the string does not contain the literal `false`. Keep the same classes.

findings.title: Reports count loses its dark-mode colour
findings.fixPrompt: In `apps/posts/src/views/comments/components/comments-list.tsx` (around line 307), the reports indicator uses `text-yellow-600` with no dark-mode variant. The old report badge used `text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-500`. Restore the dark variant, or use the project's standard warning token, so the highlight stays readable in dark mode.

findings.title: Commented-out avatar block left in the component
findings.body:
A commented-out `AvatarImage` block is left in the render output. The avatar always falls back to the user icon, which is what the author intends for now, but the dead block will confuse readers about whether avatars are supported. Either remove it or add a short comment explaining why it is disabled.

::code{file="apps/posts/src/views/comments/components/comments-list.tsx" lines="200-204"}
findings.fixPrompt: In `apps/posts/src/views/comments/components/comments-list.tsx` (around lines 200-204), remove the commented-out `AvatarImage` block inside the member `Avatar`, or replace it with a one-line comment saying why avatar images are not shown yet (for example, the API does not return them for members). Keep the `AvatarFallback` behaviour unchanged.

findings.title: Brittle regex post-processing to remove the date comma
findings.fixPrompt: In `apps/posts/src/views/comments/components/comments-list.tsx` (lines 60-71), `formatDate` removes the day-year comma with a regex on the output of `Intl.DateTimeFormat`. This is brittle and depends on ICU output. Replace it with a formatting approach that does not post-process strings, for example `formatToParts`, or accept the default comma output. Keep the displayed format consistent with the tooltip text.

findings.title: No tests cover the redesigned list
findings.fixPrompt: Add a unit test for `CommentsList` in `apps/posts/src/views/comments/components/` (follow any existing test setup in `apps/posts`). Render it with a few comments in published, hidden, and deleted states. Assert that the Hide and Show buttons appear for the right statuses, that the overflow menu includes "Delete comment" for non-deleted comments only, and that choosing it opens the "Delete comment?" dialog. Also assert that clicking the member and post buttons calls `onAddFilter` with the expected field and id.

findings.title: Required onAddFilter prop with its caller in place
findings.body:
Making `onAddFilter` required and removing the `onAddFilter &&` guards is a good cleanup. The only caller, `comments.tsx`, always passes `handleAddFilter`, so the optional prop was never meaningfully optional. The type now matches what the component needs at runtime.

::code{file="apps/posts/src/views/comments/components/comments-list.tsx" lines="128-136"}

findings.title: Backend feature_image addition is minimal and matches its snapshots
findings.body:
Adding `feature_image` to the admin comment `postFields` whitelist is the smallest change that feeds the new image column. The Comment type gets the matching optional field, and the e2e `comments` snapshots show the extra key for each post. The activity-feed changes update only header `content-length` values, and the body snapshot uses `data: anyObject`, so it does not need the new field. The change stays scoped to the admin serializer.
